title: The 4 Best Patio Heaters Under $300
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for patio heaters under $300, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at patio heaters under $300 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: AZ Patio Heaters Tall Outdoor Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 48,000 BTU propane burner, 87-inch hammered bronze standing design, 10 to 15 foot heat radius.
strengths: 48,000 BTU and a 10 to 15 foot radius are enough for most single-family patios or decks
limitations: Still an open-flame propane heater, requiring real floor clearance
Visually bulky for a smaller or more design-conscious space

products.name: Amazon Basics Stainless Steel Commercial Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 46,000 BTU stainless steel construction, Includes a stand-up patio heater cover, Wheeled base.
strengths: Commercial rating means it's built for regular, heavy outdoor use
Stainless steel resists corrosion better than painted finishes over multiple seasons
limitations: Stainless steel shows fingerprints and water spots more visibly than a bronze finish
Similar BTU output to cheaper options, the premium here is mostly build and accessories
Bulky to store even with the included cover on
features: Includes a stand-up patio heater cover

products.name: Dr. Infrared Heater Carbon Infrared Patio Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 120V / 1500W carbon infrared element, 3 heat settings, IP55 weatherproof rating.
strengths: IP55 rating and multiple mount options make it flexible across patio, porch, or balcony
No propane tank to buy, store, or refill
limitations: Smaller effective heat radius than the propane standing heaters on this list
Needs an outdoor-rated outlet or hardwire
Doesn't match the raw BTU-equivalent output of a full-size propane heater

products.name: EAST OAK 55,000 BTU Propane Patio Heater with Table
limitations: Uses a 20 lb tank quickly on high

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
